items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Baptiste Delil maybe? No, Johnny. Johnny.

ctx.x: Who was a trombone player with Robo Show? Who was a trombone player? Oak Gasper. Not Oak. No, Oak's brother. What's his name? Victor. Yeah, Vic Gasper. He was a trombone player. Johnny, Johnny, Johnny, Johnny, Johnny, Johnny should play trombone with him too.
Baptiste Delil maybe? No, Johnny. Johnny.

But T-Ball, Gemma, he was with us after I had the band. Who? Eddie Gemma, we called him T-Ball. That's right, he played bass, then he got on trombone after. Oh, Johnny Lindsey. Lindsey, yeah, yeah, yeah. He lost his mind too about four years ago.
